summary: Racemethionine (DL-methionine) is used in liver tonics and as a urinary acidifier. L-methionine is an oral alternative antidote for paracetamol poisoning when acetylcysteine is unavailable (2.5 g every 4 hours for 4 doses, within 10 to 12 hours).
